text: The VIX is at 35.89 — well above the 25 stress threshold — while CPI is running at 4.1% with a possible December rate hike on the table, meaning market volatility is elevated and conditions favor caution over aggressive new positions.
IONQ is down 36% with the worst momentum in your portfolio, no earnings to support the valuation, and cash burn in a speculative sector — exit this position to free up capital for stronger holdings.

PLTR trades at 56.5x earnings, making it your most expensive holding by a wide margin — in a high-VIX environment with potential rate hikes ahead, trimming some of this richly valued position reduces your portfolio's vulnerability to a sharp pullback.
Raise your LLY stop from $1,040.58 to $1,093.82 to lock in more of your gains while still giving the stock room to breathe.

Adobe looks genuinely undervalued at 7.9x earnings with over 10% revenue growth and best-in-class 11.6% free cash flow yield — this pullback in a proven business is worth adding to, though size modestly given the elevated VIX.

GOOGL is down 19% on your position but still delivering 15% revenue growth at a reasonable valuation — the fundamentals haven't broken, making this a sensible spot to average down in small increments.
